data.narrative:
CuspAI is a Series A AI & Software company founded by Max Welling and Chad Edwards that has raised $100M+. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of nine private companies and one public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR), with top private peers including Reflection AI, Scale AI, Figure AI, and Applied Intuition.

Two valuation methods are applicable. The stage-progression approach uses the $100M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier from Series A to the next stage, yielding an implied value of $200M. The peer-median method examines five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $2.0B (Field AI) to $29.0B (Scale AI), producing a median implied value of $5.6B. The dispersion reflects varying stage maturity—Scale AI and Reflection AI command premium valuations at Series B, while Physical Intelligence, Black Forest Labs, and Field AI occupy the $2B–$5.6B range.

Triangulating these methods produces a valuation range of $170M (floor, conservative stage-progression variant) to $6.4B (ceiling). The median point of $2.9B reflects the peer-median result anchored by the broader dataset. Key uncertainties include CuspAI's specific revenue trajectory, customer concentration, and competitive positioning relative to the high-valuation outliers in the peer set. The wide range ($170M–$6.4B) underscores sensitivity to stage progression assumptions and peer selection within a volatile frontier-AI market.
